name: orboto/mail
description: Official PHP SDK for the Orboto Mail Service. Drop-in transactional-mail client with auto-quota-tracking, retry-with-backoff, quota lifecycle events, typed DTOs, and a Laravel Service-Provider out of the box. EU-hosted, GDPR-compliant.

suggest.guzzlehttp/guzzle: Default PSR-18 HTTP client (any PSR-18 implementation works)
suggest.illuminate/support: Required when using the Laravel Service-Provider (Laravel 11+)

PKSA-zwc5-qtrz-zm1n.reason: Transitive via illuminate/notifications -> illuminate/mail (dev-only dependency for the Laravel Service-Provider test surface). The Orboto SDK never instantiates illuminate/mail at runtime; it ships its own HttpClient against SES. Blocking the update would gate every PHP CI install.
